s.note: Billy's new foster home in Philadelphia
s.how: Freeze a 400g rib eye for 30 minutes and shave thin. Sear with a sliced onion in oil. Lay 6 slices provolone over to melt, then pile onto 12 toasted slider buns.

s.note: Freddy's the brains of the operation
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen potato gems at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Toss straight away with 1 tsp garlic salt and 40g grated parmesan and serve with tomato sauce.

m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 1 onion and 1 red capsicum. Add 300g rice, a pinch of saffron, 1 tsp paprika and 750ml stock and nestle in the chicken. Cover and bake at 180C for 35 minutes, then stir through 100g peas and olives.

w.note: the Rock of Eternity where Billy meets the wizard
w.how: Melt 400g dark chocolate. Stir through 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted almonds, 100g broken plain sweet biscuits and 30g coconut. Press into a lined tin, chill until set and cut into chunks.

d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g sugar. Heat 600ml milk, 200ml cream, a cinnamon stick and nutmeg until steaming, then whisk slowly into the yolks and cook gently until it coats a spoon. Chill, then serve with grated nutmeg and 120ml brandy on the side.
